issues.problem: Live window capture corrupts nested Slate hit-test dimensions, causing an ensure on the next editor tick.
issues.fix: Use native Slate TakeScreenshot for screen and asset editor captures; keep actual dimensions and bounded downscale.

issues.problem: Screen output calls the active PIE window the editor window.
issues.next: Report actual captured window title/type and distinguish whole-window from viewport.

issues.problem: Material editor capture lacks graph fit/target controls and does not establish shader readiness.
issues.next: Focused material graph framing and preview-ready workflow.

issues.problem: No dedicated level or PIE viewport capture with explicit viewport/camera target.
issues.next: Define viewport selection, resolution, chrome exclusion and frame freshness.

issues.problem: Test project uses CommonUI without CommonGameViewportClient.
issues.next: Review test project configuration before claiming CommonUI runtime acceptance.

issues.problem: Capture help overloads Size as dimensions or neighbour depth; dense overview lacks a readability warning and editor results include long implementation catalogs.
issues.next: Simplify output and teach overview-to-detail workflow without implying every image is readable.

planned_scenarios: High DPI, multi-monitor, occluded windows and HDR
